Package hadur2.core.ledger

package hadur2.core.ledger
The energy ledger: deciding which of the enemy's energy drops are bullets (WAVE-1, WAVE-2).

A duel robot never sees the enemy's bullets; it infers each shot from the energy the enemy spent on it and surfs a wave from there. EnergyLedger holds the tick's hits, refunds and collisions until the enemy's next scan, infers wall hits from a sudden stop next to a wall, and reports the drop left over as a EnergyLedger.Reading. Only a remainder in [0.1, 3.0] is a shot. HadurCore turns a shot into the enemy's firing wave and feeds its power to the enemy gun-heat estimate that END-1 reads.

Dependencies, enforced by ArchitectureTest: the ledger may use only itself, the physics package (the engine's rules, Rules) and the JDK, so nothing the gun, the movement or the rest of the core believes can change which drops become waves. Like the whole core it uses no robocode.* class (CORE-1) and no randomness, threads, reflection, I/O or clock (RES-6). No duel package is allowed to depend on the melee or posture packages, this one included. The package is one of the duel's, pinned by DuelIdentityTest.
